## Webinars

WestGrid's bi-weekly training webinars take place every second Wednesday at 10am Pacific / 11am Mountain
/ 12pm Central.

To view recordings and slides from past sessions, click on the linked title.

| TOPIC | DATE | Speaker |
| ------------- | --------- | ----------------- |

| [<span style="color:blue">File access control approaches and best practices</span>](/tools/rdm#acl) | Oct-30 | Sergiy Stepanenko |
| [<span style="color:blue">Building a bioinformatics QC pipeline</span>](/domains/bioinfo) | Nov-13 | Brian McConeghy |

| [<span style="color:blue">Geospatial analysis with HPC</span>](/domains/geo#geospatial) | Dec-11 | Ian Percel |
